title: Functional chimeric mRNAs encode proteins in mammalian immunity.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Found three GEO (Gene Expression Omnibus) series by keyword search (none linked from PubMed): GSE267147 (long-read direct RNA sequencing, 10 samples), GSE324139 (short-read, 12 samples), GSE324391 (Hi-C chromosome contact maps, 12 .hic files, 5.7 GB tar, not downloaded). Downloaded and opened both small RAW tars: every file is a Salmon quant.sf with 140,790 standard Ensembl mouse transcripts (ENSMUST IDs) and zero chimeric/fusion transcript entries. Opened GSE267147 LCPM xlsx: 11,377 genes x 10 samples (NT/M1/M2 macrophage states), gene-level log counts only.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about the chimeric transcript calls (how many, which gene pairs, validation status) comes from the abstract only; the Nature full text and supplementary tables are paywalled, not in Europe PMC, and were not retrievable, so the list of discovered chimeras was never seen.

a1_downloadable.note: GEO processed files download freely (checked); raw reads in SRA (Sequence Read Archive) not fetched by policy. Paper supplement, which likely holds the chimera list, is paywalled.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked files: deposited tables are ordinary transcript/gene expression against the standard Ensembl reference, with no chimeric-transcript column or list. A chimera label would have to be constructed by re-running fusion detection on raw long reads.

a3_inputs_present.note: Expression values present for 140,790 transcripts; sequences would need the Ensembl reference, a standard download.

a4_units_stated.note: Salmon TPM (transcripts per million) and NumReads columns; xlsx is log CPM (counts per million) with prior count 1, stated in file name.

a5_enough_rows.note: The sample unit is 10 long-read + 12 short-read macrophage libraries from one lab; the paper's validated chimera set is reported as a handful plus one functional protein (abstract), far below ~400 labels.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Processed files are tiny; Hi-C is 5.7 GB but not needed.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Cannot compare to paper sample counts (full text unavailable); GEO filelists match the archives opened.

a8_label_provenance.note: Any chimera label we could build would be the output of a fusion-calling pipeline (a model) on our own re-processing, not the authors' validated calls, which are not deposited in machine-readable form we could find.

existing_models.name: CTAT-LR-Fusion (long-read fusion transcript caller)
existing_models.score_and_split: Not retrieved; protocol chapter only seen in search results.

existing_models.name: LongGF (long-read gene fusion detector)
existing_models.score_and_split: Reported accurate on simulated and real cancer data (BMC Genomics abstract); split details not retrieved.

existing_models.name: RTCpredictor (read-through chimeric RNA identifier)
existing_models.score_and_split: Not retrieved; Briefings in Bioinformatics 2024 title seen only.

honest_claim_h3: With only 22 bulk libraries from one lab and no deposited chimera list, a model could at most claim to re-detect fusion transcripts in mouse bone-marrow macrophages that our own caller found, which is not a learned biological prediction.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the sequence and inflammation-linked expression of gene pairs to predict which pairs form protein-coding chimeric messenger RNAs in immune cells.
plain_idea.train_on: Gene pairs from mouse macrophage RNA sequencing, with expression in resting vs inflamed states; the number of labelled chimeric pairs is unknown because the list is not in the deposited files.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a gene pair forms a chimeric transcript, with truth coming from long-read direct RNA sequencing calls validated by the authors (paper supplement, not accessible).
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Immunologists could prioritise candidate fusion proteins for validation; but the labelled set is tiny and not deposited, so the project is not defined.

ml_idea: Classify gene pairs as chimera-forming from sequence and inflammation-responsive expression/3D contact features; infeasible because the chimera calls are not deposited and the sample count is 22 libraries.

effort.compute_note: Only measured file sizes of processed GEO data; no modelling estimate since Part A failed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Grep deposited quant files for non-Ensembl (chimeric) transcript IDs: done, found 0, so labels are absent.

verdict_reason: A2/A5/A8 fail: the opened GEO files (GSE267147, GSE324139) hold only standard Ensembl expression for 22 macrophage libraries with no chimeric-transcript list; the chimera calls sit in a paywalled supplement and would otherwise have to be rebuilt from raw reads with a fusion caller.
